kubernetes:
# Swag: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-swag/blob/master/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
# Security notes:
#   - capability NET_ADMIN: Required for fail2Ban to be able to modify iptables rules..
#   - readOnlyRootFilesystem is supported by this image; enable it once /config and /tmp are mounted.
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: swag-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: swag
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  PUID: '1000'
  PGID: '1000'
  TZ: Etc/UTC
  URL: example.com
  VALIDATION: http
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: swag-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: swag
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: swag
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: swag
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: swag
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: swag
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: swag
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/swag:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: swag-env
        ports:
        - name: port-443
          containerPort: 443
          protocol: TCP
        volumeMounts:
        - name: swag-config
          mountPath: /config
        securityContext:
          capabilities:
            add:
            - NET_ADMIN
      volumes:
      - name: swag-config
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: swag-config
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: swag
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: swag
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: swag
  ports:
  - name: port-443
    port: 443
    targetPort: 443
    protocol: TCP
quadlet:
# swag.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-swag/blob/master/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Swag (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/swag:latest
ContainerName=swag
AutoUpdate=registry
AddCapability=NET_ADMIN
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=TZ=Etc/UTC
Environment=URL=example.com
Environment=VALIDATION=http
# Environment=SUBDOMAINS=www,
# Environment=CERTPROVIDER=
# Environment=CERT_PROFILE=
# Environment=DNSPLUGIN=cloudflare
# Environment=PROPAGATION=
# Environment=EMAIL=
# Environment=ONLY_SUBDOMAINS=false
# Environment=EXTRA_DOMAINS=
# Environment=STAGING=false
# Environment=DISABLE_F2B=
# Environment=SWAG_AUTORELOAD=
# Environment=SWAG_AUTORELOAD_WATCHLIST=
Volume=/path/to/swag/config:/config:Z
PublishPort=443:443
# PublishPort=80:80
# PublishPort=443:443/udp

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
